title: Jet Set Medium Pebbled Leather Convertible Wristlet
description_html:
Jet Set Medium Pebbled Leather Convertible Wristlet by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 8.25”W X 4.5” H X 1.25”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop 5.5”
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Silver-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
